resources.limits: Runner database isolated; PostgreSQL service/host shared with normal stack. No competing test/build workload; normal stack CPU load not instrumented.

policy.late_emission: Never emit after the arrival window; count as not emitted
policy.final_pending: Classify as failed/timeout at fixed drain deadline
policy.emission: Async coroutine begins whole HTTP transaction, before connection/open/read; event-loop scheduling wait included in generator delay
policy.justification: 20rps gives 50ms intervals: p95 jitter 1/5 interval, p99 1/2 interval, max two intervals; zero missing arrivals preserves full18000. Drain70s=timeout65s+5s margin.
policy.request_timeout_scope: 65s total across connection, headers and body
policy.client_concurrency: No pending-request cap; per-request65s timeout bounds outstanding lifetime

dataset.limits: State fixtures cloned from native seed_demo publication; shared synthetic media, no claim of10k native moderation or duplicate calibration.
dataset.deployment_step: Publication state current for rules 03499040c863: 10002 recomputed

diagnosis.cause_1: Fixture drafts created by bulk_create after the deployment step bypass model signals; with no worker/Beat in the harness the fixture listing stays dirty for the whole run and every listing/search evaluates it natively: +28-43 ms per request in-process (73->101 ms, 77->120 ms).
diagnosis.cause_2: Bulk-loaded tables without planner statistics: listings 98->80 ms in-process after ANALYZE.
diagnosis.control: Same harness routes, analyzed DB, no dirty marks, no upload, 20 RPS 30 s with the project-independent generator: p50 87 ms, p95 132 ms, no queue (diagnostic only, not R5).
